    Constructors in edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.projection with parameters of type MapTheme
    Modifier
    Constructor
    Description
     
    LambertEqualAreaProjection(double centerLon, double centerLat, MapTheme theme)
    Convenience constructor that sets both the center and the theme atomically, preventing the NullPointerException that arises when drawing methods are called before the theme is set.
     
    LambertEqualAreaProjection(MapTheme theme)
    Convenience constructor centered at (0°, 0°) with the given theme.
     
    MercatorProjection(MapTheme theme)
    Creates a Mercator projection with the supplied theme and the default central longitude of -70° (centred on the western Atlantic).
     
    MollweideProjection(MapTheme theme)
    Creates a Mollweide projection with the supplied theme and the default central meridian of -70°.
     
    OrthographicProjection(double centerLon, double centerLat, MapTheme theme)
    Convenience constructor that sets both the center and the theme in a single step, eliminating the NullPointerException risk of calling OrthographicProjection.drawMapOutline(java.awt.Graphics2D, edu.cnu.mdi.container.IContainer) before the theme is set.
